messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning private rollout for AcmeCorp on Dedicated (v2.1.3) tonight. Change window 2025-03-26 23:00-01:00 UTC. Need approvals: security, oncall, customer notice, and version pin. Deploy bot preflight below.

deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK: build=sha1:ab12cd34, ci=green, infra-health=ok, model-bundle-pkg=ready. Full artifact: https://ci.company/builds/ab12cd34
```
preflight: OK
- unit tests: pass
- integration: pass
- perf smoke: pass
- infra quota: available
```

ajay: I can approve if we have a clear rollback and pin plan. Who owns rollback? Also confirm no incompatible cache/schema changes.

sam: Proposal: staged rollout -> canary 5% (eu-west) at 23:05, monitor 15m, ramp to 25% at 23:25, 100% at 23:55 if metrics OK. Key thresholds: p95 latency < 300ms, error-rate < 0.5%, tail OOMs = 0. If breach, auto-fallback to pinned version.

elena: No DB schema migrations in this release. There is a KV cache format tweak but it's backward-compatible. I'll run a cache-compat check at 22:00 and post results here.

rachel: Customer-facing: Acme requires 48h notice for planned infra changes per contract. Marcus (Acme) SMS'd: \"We can accept a shorter window for non-SLA impacting fixes, but require rollback plan and a dedicated support line.\" I pinged him and he asked for the rollback command.

ajay: Rollback command (manual):
```
# rollback to previous stable
redwoodctl rollback --customer acme --to v2.1.2 --reason "post-deploy rollback"
```
Also add an automatic fallback config: `fallback_version: v2.1.2`, health-check webhook set to https://hooks.redwood/status/acme

maya: We'll pin v2.1.3 for Acme during the rollout window. Pin command (console + CLI):
```
# pin for Acme
redwoodctl pin --customer acme --version v2.1.3 --expires 168h
```
I'll also add an automatic-fallback to v2.1.2 in the rollout policy.

sam: Release notes snippet for support ticket / changelog: 
```
v2.1.3 (private/dedicated)
- Reduced transformer kv-cache memory usage (~12% lower)
- Fixes: resolved rare OOM on long-sequence generation
- Performance: 8-12% p95 improve for short prompts
```

elena: Compatibility check done at 22:04: cache format compatible, warm cache script passes on staging. No action required. Logs: https://ci.company/artifacts/compat/acme/22-04

oncall-bot: NOTIFY #oncall -> pager: ajay. Escalation policy: 30m -> eng-sre -> oncall lead. Pager contact added.

rachel: I've updated Acme support ticket with change window, canary plan, rollback steps, and on-call contact. Marcus ACK: \"OK as long as rollback is tested. Marcus will be on standby.\"

ajay: I run the smoke tests post-canary: `./tools/smoke-test-acme.sh` — will be ready. I approve the rollout contingent on the staged plan and fallback configured. :thumbsup: 

maya: All approvals noted. Rolling plan: 23:00 start, deploy canary at 23:05 (5% eu-west), hold 30m, ramp per Sam's schedule. Rollout owner: maya. Rollback owner: ajay. If any metric breach or customer concern, we revert via `redwoodctl rollback`.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: deploy-job id=deploy-20250326-acme-01 assigned -> executor: k8s-team-24. Canary config: 5% traffic, region=eu-west, fallback=v2.1.2. CI job: https://ci.company/jobs/deploy-20250326-acme-01

maya: I'll run the pin and kick the job at 23:00. If we don't get last-minute objections by 22:30 we'll proceed.

elena: Leaving monitoring hooks in place: traces, logs, kv-warmers. I'll post quick health summary at 23:45.

rachel: Customer contact Marcus and support channel are on standby. I attached a short release note for them.

ajay: ack and standby on pager.

maya: :shipit: launching canary at 23:05. Will post canary metrics once available.
